result.summary: Found 1 issue: delivery metadata text under the popular restaurant card is broken/overlapping, making the time unreadable.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the delivery line renders as '25–30delivery · Ramen' — the 'min' label is missing/collapsed into 'delivery', so the estimated time reads incorrectly.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text layout so the time and unit don't overlap (e.g. '25–30 min delivery · Ramen'), ensuring adequate spacing and no truncation between the time value and 'delivery'.
